author: Monty

decisions.choice: Use the traditional nonfinal i-it reading for this lexical path, with no idit-num. Preserve the modern note as disagreement; do not alter PG4 preprocessing.

evidence.anchor: अस्मिन् धातौ औपदेशिकस्वरूपे विद्यमानः इकारः उच्चारणार्थः स्थापितः अस्ति, इत्संज्ञकः नास्ति । अपि च, आर्धधातुकप्रत्ययस्य विषये <<चक्षिङः ख्याञ्>> [[2.4.54]] इत्यनेन सूत्रेण अस्य धातोः ख्याञ् (केषाञ्चन मतेन क्शाञ्) इति आदेशः भवति ।

decisions.choice: The sūtra and Bālamanoramā prescribe dental th. The pinned Kāśikā field says dh; it is not used for this replacement.
Use the explicit weak i prescription and Kāśikā daridritaḥ. The shorter Siddhāntakaumudī field reads daridrataḥ and is not taken as that cell witness.

evidence.anchor: दरिद्रातेर्हलादौ सार्वधातुके क्ङिति परत इकारादेशो भवति। दरिद्रितः।

decisions.choice: The 7.3.93 Bālamanoramā field discusses sanvat/caṅ. Use the directly relevant Kāśikā and Siddhāntakaumudī passages instead.

evidence.anchor: ब्रू इत्येतस्मादुत्तरस्य हलादेः पितः सार्वधातुकस्येडागमो भवति

decisions.choice: Apply 8.2.36 then 8.2.41 to mārṣ+si, giving mārkṣi. The pinned Bālamanoramā 7.2.114 token mārṣi is recorded as conflicting, not selected as a witness.
Use Siddhāntakaumudī dh-initial-affix lopa in the five admitted s-final roots. Kāśikā discusses a narrower sic-only reading.
